title: bromus cristatus
intro: Bromus cristatus, commonly known as Japanese brome or Japanese chess, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is a perennial grass native to East Asia, particularly in Japan, China, and Korea. The health benefits of Bromus cristatus include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
